officialHeroApi.biography: 胡金定是传说中关羽之妻，关索之母。刘、关、张结义后，刘备恐关、张家有妻室，不能生死同心。张飞就与关羽相约，交换处理妻小。后张飞见胡金定有身孕，心生怜悯，便放走了胡金定。后来胡金定生下一子，即关索。

row.o: 锁定技，游戏开始时，你选择一名其他角色。当你首次受到伤害后，你再选择一名其他角色。每回合限一次，当以此法选择的角色获得牌后，你获得其中随机一名角色一张手牌。
你本轮获得的红色牌可当【闪】使用。

supports: Both mandatory selections must be other, distinct characters. A marked character gaining hand cards can trigger once in any actual turn. With two marks, the random hand holder can be the non-gaining marked character; a handless marked character is excluded. Current-round red hand cards have a Zhongshen label, while equipment in the equipment zone cannot supply Dodge.

Qingyuan partner labels are public, cannot be transferred after a partner dies, and its second selection follows the first actual damage instance regardless of points. Losing HP is not damage. Native draws and hand transfers qualify; direct equipment entry does not. A random card comes from the chosen holder entire hand, not just the newly gained cards. Zhongshen supplies a used Dodge against Slash, and cannot play out Dodge for Arrow Barrage. Only the hand zone supplies material.

duplicateAudit.result: No existing Hu Jin Ding, Qingyuan or Zhongshen character/skill manifest at preflight. This is ordinary current OL gid594, not anniversary Deshi or another product.

implementationDecisions.rule: Record each owner first actually applied damage independently of skill source availability; freeze its native damage frame, original parent and actual amount. Opening and first-damage choices are mandatory and cannot choose oneself or any previously selected partner. New triggers require the exact living current source instance; a paid random transfer drains its children after source loss or owner death.
implementationDecisions.status: official wording plus native damage contract

implementationDecisions.rule: Freeze exact source, native batch and first real marked-person Hand gain at batch completion. Exclude same-owner hand rearrangement, refunded Processing payment and equipment-only entry. Two marked people gaining in one batch yield one source opportunity. Each actual turn permits one take; extra Play phases do not reset it.

At activation uniformly choose among currently living marked people with nonempty hands, then uniformly choose a card from the selected complete native hand. Use the native deterministic RNG, freezing both candidate collections and chosen indexes before the actual Hand-to-Hand move. The holder and card are never chosen by foreign face inspection; hidden card identities remain trusted receipt data.
implementationDecisions.status: official guide plus native random contract

implementationDecisions.rule: A real RoundStarted boundary freezes the movement sequence. Only a currently owned Hand entity with a genuine gain to this hand after that boundary qualifies; initial setup cards, prior-round-only gains, same-owner rearrangements, equipment and Wooden Ox grain do not. Current native effective red color is required. Actual reacquisition after a reshuffle is a new gain, and the next real round expires prior-round entitlement. Normal native UseOnly response directions reject AOE played-out Dodge.
implementationDecisions.status: official guide plus native round and movement contract

implementationDecisions.rule: Qingyuan markers identify selected people publicly. Zhongshen badges are computed purely for already visible native card faces; other viewers do not receive hidden hand IDs or frozen random hand candidates.
